title: Claude’s new voice mode isn’t chasing natural. It’s chasing your to-do list.
excerpt: Anthropic wants you to talk to Claude, and then watch it act. On Thursday it upgraded Claude’s voice mode to run on its most capable models, Opus and Sonnet, the company announced. content_html:
Anthropic wants you to talk to Claude, and then watch it act. On Thursday it upgraded Claude’s voice mode to run on its most capable models, Opus and Sonnet, the company announced.

Voice mode launched last year, and until now it ran only on Haiku, Anthropic’s fastest but shallowest model. That was fine for quick questions. But people started using it to work through real problems out loud, and Haiku kept things quick, Anthropic said, “but not always deep”.

The pitch is a smarter sounding board. Opus and Sonnet are built for hard problems. You can talk through a half-formed idea, and Claude will ask follow-up questions and push your thinking rather than just answer.

You switch models mid-conversation, and it uses the fastest version of whichever you pick. It defaults to the last model you used in text. Anthropic pitches it for practising a pitch, weighing two job offers, or thinking out loud before a hard call.

From talking to doing

The bigger shift is that voice mode can now act.

Connect your apps and you can tell Claude to push a meeting on Google Calendar. It can summarise the day’s emails and draft replies, or turn a spoken pitch into a one-page document in Canva. It can also reach Slack and Notion. Claude asks permission before touching a tool.

Voice mode now speaks many more languages too, including French, German, Italian, Japanese and both flavours of Spanish. You have to tell it to switch, though, as it will not detect the change on its own.

This is where Anthropic parts from OpenAI. Weeks ago, OpenAI gave ChatGPT a more natural, full-duplex voice that can listen and talk at once. Claude’s voice mode is turn-based: it listens, pauses to think, then replies. In practice that feels less fluid than ChatGPT.

Anthropic did not touch the underlying voice stack, so there are no new tricks like better interruption handling. “This release is focused on intelligence and tool access,” it told Engadget, promising “more to share later this year”.

The split is telling. OpenAI is making its assistant sound more human. Anthropic is making its assistant do your job. The new voice mode is in beta for everyone on mobile, desktop and web, though it works best on a phone.

Free users get Haiku and a single connected app. Everyone else gets the smarter models and the full set of tools, and the promise that the talking is only the start.

content_html_zh:
人类希望你与克劳德交谈，然后观看它的行动。 该公司宣布，周四升级了 Claude 的语音模式，使其可以在其功能最强大的型号 Opus 和 Sonnet 上运行。

语音模式于去年推出，到目前为止它只在 Haiku 上运行，这是 Anthropic 最快但最浅的模型。 对于快速提问来说这很好。 但人们开始用它来大声地解决实际问题，俳句让事情变得很快，Anthropic 说，“但并不总是深入”。

音调是一个更聪明的共鸣板。 Opus 和 Sonnet 是为解决难题而构建的。 你可以讨论一个半成形的想法，克劳德会提出后续问题并推动你的思考，而不仅仅是回答。

您可以在对话中切换模型，它会使用您选择的最快版本。 它默认为您在文本中使用的最后一个模型。 Anthropic 将其用于练习推销、权衡两个工作机会或在艰难的决定之前大声思考。

从说到做

更大的转变是语音模式现在可以行动了。

连接您的应用程序，您可以告诉 Claude 在 Google 日历上推送会议。 它可以总结当天的电子邮件和草稿回复，或者将口头推介转化为 Canva 中的一页文档。 它还可以到达 Slack 和 Notion。 克劳德在接触工具之前先征求许可。

语音模式现在还支持更多语言，包括法语、德语、意大利语、日语以及西班牙语。 不过，您必须告诉它进行切换，因为它不会自行检测到更改。

这就是 Anthropic 与 OpenAI 的区别。 几周前，OpenAI 为 ChatGPT 提供了更自然的全双工语音，可以同时听和说。 克劳德的语音模式是回合制的：它会听，暂停思考，然后回复。 在实践中，感觉不如 ChatGPT 流畅。

Anthropic 没有触及底层的语音堆栈，因此没有更好的中断处理等新技巧。 “这个版本的重点是情报和工具访问，”它告诉 Engadget，并承诺“今年晚些时候会分享更多内容”。

分裂很能说明问题。 OpenAI 正在使其助手听起来更加人性化。 Anthropic 正在让它的助手完成你的工作。 新的语音模式对于移动设备、桌面设备和网络上的所有人来说仍处于测试阶段，但它在手机上效果最佳。

免费用户可以获得俳句和一个连接的应用程序。 其他人都可以获得更智能的模型和全套工具，并承诺谈话只是开始。
